name: mirage
text: I found a likely cause (TR2). The all-time card is cash + open bets minus what you put in. Your last report shows it as -$244.85, but it was built from a wallet reading 13.7 hours old. The report also lists other wallet numbers ($73.16 and $877.96) from different places in the app. So each time you look, the card can show a different reading, either an old saved one or a fresh one. Cash and open bets are also read a moment apart while the engine is filling, so they can disagree. I haven't fixed this yet. The fix is to read the wallet in one step, show how old the reading is on the card, and never replace a newer reading with an older one. It's the first thing on my list after the bets.json and lag fixes. If you can, screenshot two different values and the time you saw each.
